engineering-fourier-optics.title: Engineering Fourier Optics
engineering-fourier-optics.summary: Lecture notes by NK Nguyen, part of Engineering Fourier Optics: Theory, Applications and Computation (a draft soon to be submitted to Springer). Begun from Luca Dal Negro's EC 562 and Lei Tian's EC 522 at Boston University, and expanded with derivations, figures, and Python and MATLAB code.
sources: BU ENG EC 562, Fourier Optics in Engineering
other_sources: BU ENG EC 522, Computational Optical Imaging by Lei Tian
engineering-fourier-optics.book: Engineering Fourier Optics: Theory, Applications and Computation
engineering-fourier-optics.book_status: a draft soon to be submitted to Springer
engineering-fourier-optics.about: All text and figures are my own. The draft began as my notes on Luca Dal Negro's EC 562 Fourier Optics in Engineering (Fall 2023) and Lei Tian's EC 522 Computational Optical Imaging (Spring 2024) at Boston University, and has grown well beyond them, with derivations, worked examples, and Python and MATLAB code for each section. Further application chapters, written by senior researchers and PhD students, are in progress and not yet included.
primary_sources: J. W. Goodman, Introduction to Fourier Optics, 4th ed. (W. H. Freeman, 2017)
D. G. Voelz, Computational Fourier Optics: A MATLAB Tutorial (SPIE Press, 2011)
